messages:
maria: Heads-up — changelog cutoff in ~4h for the v1.12.0 bump. Please add your one-liners to the keep-a-changelog template in the release notes PR (link: https://git.internal/r/redwood/release-notes/pull/412). Include component tags and a PR number.
release-bot: :bell: Reminder: changelog cutoff in ~3h for v1.12.0. Please add entries or they may be omitted.

sylvia: Adding mine now. Quick Q — should infra/runtime items go under 'eng-runtime' or 'infra' tag?

maria: Put runtime optimizations under eng-runtime, infra config or infra-scaling under infra. If it's cross-cutting add both tags, e.g., "eng-runtime, infra". Keep the one-liner short (1 sentence) + PR link.

jack: pinging if this counts as an entry: "Reduce host-side batching memory by avoiding double-copy during aggregation (PR #5872)" — want me to add component tag? Assuming eng-runtime.

nate: Yep, add it under eng-runtime. Example entry I pushed for my change so folks see the shape:

```
- eng-runtime: Reduce host-side batching memory by avoiding double-copy during aggregation (PR #5872)
```

olivia: I have the version-bump PR to update charts and smoke test matrix. Do you want me to add a changelog line for the bump itself? (PR #5901)

maria: Please add a brief line for the version bump under "release" tag, e.g. "release: Bump v1.12.0 and update smoke test matrix (PR #5901)". Also tag @release-manager if you need a hand with the tag/semver step.

jack: Done — added my line and PR link.

sylvia: Added infra entry too.

release-bot: :white_check_mark: Entries recorded: #5872, #5899, #5901. Cutoff in ~30m. If you still need help formatting an entry paste it here and I'll nudge the author.

maria: Great — thanks everyone. If you haven't, please add: component tag, one-line summary, PR number. I'll close the notes once cutoff hits and prep the final release blurb.
